Model Electrochemistry in a RDE Cell
Owner: ICPEES@CNRS/Unistra:Elena Savinova
Task: T2.1
Maturity: established method
Documentation: 
Range of validity or processability: 
Valid for the oxygen reactions (OER/ORR - but bubble generation of OER has to be considered) owing to thier slow kinetics, indepently of acidic/alkaline) and for all reactions when using non-Pt (i.e., slow kinetics systems). Design of the cell/choice of the reference/counter electrode has to be considered when moving from an acidic to alkaline pH range.
